name: Alphabet Inc. (Google)
monetization: Monetizes AI through Search/YouTube ads, Google Cloud (TPUs + Gemini), Gemini subscriptions, and model licensing (Apple ~$1B/yr); vertically integrated on its own TPU silicon.
description_md: Alphabet spans Google Search, YouTube, Android, Google Cloud, and DeepMind, and is the only hyperscaler running frontier models (Gemini) predominantly on its own silicon (TPUs). Google Cloud grew 82% y/y in Q2 2026 to $24.8B with a backlog above $500B, and 2026 capex guidance was raised to $195–205B. Alphabet holds an equity stake in Anthropic (~14% per court disclosures) and supplies it with up to 1M TPUs, and has extended off-balance-sheet lease backstops to miners-turned-AI landlords (TeraWulf, Cipher, Hut 8) hosting Fluidstack capacity that largely serves Anthropic.
ai_monetization_md: Four channels: (1) **Ads** — AI Overviews/Gemini integration defending and growing Search and YouTube revenue (Q2-26 total revenue $119.8B, +24% y/y). (2) **Google Cloud** — $24.8B in Q2-26 (+82% y/y) with backlog ~$514B; sells both TPU capacity and Gemini API access; landed Anthropic (up to 1M TPUs, >1GW, tens of billions of dollars, Oct 2025) and even Meta (>$10B/6yr) as customers. (3) **Model licensing** — Apple pays ~$1B/yr for a custom 1.2T-parameter Gemini powering the rebuilt Siri (announced Jan 2026). (4) **Subscriptions** — Gemini consumer tiers and Workspace AI. The Anthropic relationship is three-sided: equity stake, cloud/TPU supplier, and backstop guarantor of Anthropic's landlords' leases.
ai_strategy_md: Full-stack self-reliance: own models (Gemini), own silicon (TPU v7 Ironwood), own datacenters — insulating Alphabet from Nvidia pricing while turning TPUs into an external merchant business (Anthropic up to 1M TPUs; Anthropic's further ~3.5GW TPU-architecture capacity via Broadcom from 2027). Capex guidance raised twice to $195–205B for 2026, mainly technical infrastructure. Capacity is extended off-balance-sheet through backstops of Fluidstack's leases at TeraWulf, Cipher and Hut 8 sites (~$4.6B contingent support plus warrants of ~14% of TeraWulf and ~5.4% of Cipher), securing TPU-era capacity without owning the shells. DeepMind anchors the research franchise; Waymo the physical-AI option.
risk_notes_md: **Off-balance-sheet contingents:** the Fluidstack lease backstops (~$3.2B TeraWulf, ~$1.4–1.7B Cipher, Hut 8 amount undisclosed) are contingent obligations that only bind in the downside scenario where the AI tenant fails — a structure regulators flag as spv_shift-adjacent. **Circularity:** Alphabet is simultaneously equity holder in, supplier to, and backstop guarantor around Anthropic; TPU revenue quality depends partly on a counterparty Alphabet helps fund. **Capex escalation:** guidance rose $15B mid-year; GOOGL sold off on the hike. **Concentration of new Cloud backlog** in frontier labs whose own funding is not fully identified. **Antitrust:** remedies in the search case and the Apple relationship (both the legacy default-placement payments and the new Gemini license) remain regulatory exposure points.
